scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 5173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.check: node --check site-config.js && node --check redesign.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-hosting-release.mjs && firebase deploy --only hosting --config .firebase-hosting-release.json --project vjs-nationwide-services
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,functions,firestore --project vjs-nationwide-services
